title: mpeg descriptor: add NorDig Logical Channel Descriptor v1 and v2
description:
Add as usual DVB descriptors. A specification was taken from NorDig Unified Requirements 3.1.2.
Formally, private descriptors have to be used after Private Data Specifier (0x5F) but
DVB operators often ignore this rule. So I didn't limit the descriptors parsing by Nordig
private data specifier (0x00000029).
